name: obsidian-bookmarks
title: Obsidian Bookmarks
description: Search, browse, and add bookmarks stored in your Obsidian vault. Also searches Chrome and Safari bookmarks.
author: dru89

commands.name: search-bookmarks
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.description: Search through your Obsidian bookmarks, Chrome bookmarks, and Safari bookmarks

commands.name: add-bookmark

preferences.name: searchFolders
